$comment: Modal Extension Schema (Derived). A derived Extension type for the popup domain that adds the presentation properties the shell's dialog layer renders with.

label.$comment: Display label for the extension in host UI (e.g., the dialog's accessible name)

icon.$comment: Icon identifier for the extension in host UI (e.g., Iconify icon name with prefix)

order.$comment: Sort order for the extension in host UI lists (lower = higher priority)

size.$comment: How the dialog layer presents the modal: full covers the whole viewport, medium is a centred panel over a backdrop

cancelable.$comment: Whether the user can close the modal from the UI (Escape key, close button). false means the user cannot close it; only the host can unmount it.

presentation.$comment: Presentation metadata for modal domain extensions. Drives the dialog layer the shell renders around the popup domain's slot.
